title: Zebra Tower
statementMd:
Little Janet likes playing with cubes. Actually, she likes to play with anything whatsoever, cubes or tesseracts, as long as they are multicolored. Each cube is described by two parameters — color $*c*_{*i*}$ and size $*s*_{*i*}$. A Zebra Tower is a tower that consists of cubes of exactly two colors. Besides, the colors of the cubes in the tower must alternate (colors of adjacent cubes must differ). The Zebra Tower should have at least two cubes. There are no other limitations. The figure below shows an example of a Zebra Tower.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fbdd39635c53ca02f41685270d765f95e0f34e82.png)

A Zebra Tower's height is the sum of sizes of all cubes that form the tower. Help little Janet build the Zebra Tower of the maximum possible height, using the available cubes.

## Input

The first line contains an integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of cubes. Next $*n*$ lines contain the descriptions of the cubes, one description per line. A cube description consists of two space-separated integers $*c*_{*i*}$ and $*s*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *c*_{*i*}, *s*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the $*i*$-th cube's color and size, correspondingly. It is guaranteed that there are at least two cubes of different colors.

## Output

Print the description of the Zebra Tower of the maximum height in the following form. In the first line print the tower's height, in the second line print the number of cubes that form the tower, and in the third line print the space-separated indices of cubes in the order in which they follow in the tower from the bottom to the top. Assume that the cubes are numbered from 1 to $*n*$ in the order in which they were given in the input.

If there are several existing Zebra Towers with maximum heights, it is allowed to print any of them.

Please do not use the `%lld` specificator to read or write 64-bit integers in С++. It is preferred to use the `cin`, `cout` streams or the `%I64d` specificator.
statementZhMd:
Janet 喜欢玩立方体。实际上，只要是多彩的东西，无论是立方体还是超立方体，她都喜欢玩。每个立方体由两个参数描述——颜色 $*c*_{*i*}$ 和大小 $*s*_{*i*}$。斑马塔是一座由恰好两种颜色的立方体组成的塔。此外，塔中立方体的颜色必须交替出现（相邻立方体的颜色必须不同）。斑马塔至少应包含两个立方体。除此之外没有其他限制。下图展示了一个斑马塔的例子。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fbdd39635c53ca02f41685270d765f95e0f34e82.png)

斑马塔的高度是组成塔的所有立方体大小之和。请帮助 Janet 使用现有的立方体搭建出高度尽可能大的斑马塔。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$）——立方体的数量。接下来 $*n*$ 行，每行包含一个立方体的描述。每个描述由两个以空格分隔的整数 $*c*_{*i*}$ 和 $*s*_{*i*}$ 组成（$1 ≤ *c*_{*i*}, *s*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），分别表示第 $*i*$ 个立方体的颜色和大小。保证至少存在两个颜色不同的立方体。

## 输出格式

请按以下格式输出高度最大的斑马塔的描述。第一行输出塔的高度，第二行输出组成塔的立方体数量，第三行按从下到上的顺序输出组成塔的立方体编号，编号之间用空格分隔。假设立方体按照输入中的顺序编号为 1 到 $*n*$。

如果存在多个高度最大的斑马塔，可以输出其中任意一个。

请不要在 С++ 中使用 `%lld` 指定符来读写 64 位整数。建议使用 `cin`、`cout` 流或 `%I64d` 指定符。
